turnaround_reason: Atkins/Quest nutrition-snack maker got beaten down as Atkins sales eroded and the OWYN integration disappointed; net sales -6.3% and a Q3 FY26 net loss (largely a goodwill/impairment charge). Longtime operator Joe Scalzo returned as President in Jan 2026 to run an explicit turnaround.
bullish_points: Forward P/E ~6.2 — very cheap vs history for a branded consumables name
Real free cash flow (~$107M TTM) despite the reported net loss
Credible, incentivized turnaround leader (Scalzo) back at the helm
Quest brand still healthy; OWYN adds protein-shake shelf space
bearish_points: Atkins in structural decline; category faces GLP-1 appetite-suppression headwind
Management itself says it's in the 'early stages' with 'significant work ahead'
Revenue still shrinking (-6.3%); no confirmed inflection yet
catalyst: Evidence Scalzo's plan is re-igniting Quest/OWYN volume and stabilizing Atkins in the next 1-2 print(s)
catalyst_timing: Q4 FY26 earnings (Oct 2026) and FY27 guide
suggested_trade: Small starter spot near $10-11; add only on a confirmed volume inflection
key_risk: GLP-1s permanently shrink the low-carb/snack category faster than the brand refresh can offset
would_skip_if: Next print shows continued Quest deceleration or no margin stabilization
